title: File requests
bodyHtml:
File requests

Publish asks for speaker uploads (slides, PDFs) and track fulfillments from admin.

Where file requests live

Open Admin → File requests (operator). Create a request, publish it, and speakers see it under the portal File requests tab. Fulfillments show on the admin request once a speaker uploads.

Speaker flow

Accepted speakers open the portal, open File requests, and upload against each published ask. Incomplete asks surface on readiness when configured.

Where this lives in the app

  • /admin/file-requests
  • /portal

Open these routes on your demo or local host while you follow the steps above.
